title: Copilot Scheduled Prompts Move Off Power Platform: Migrate Before Dec 31
author: epifive
summary:
Microsoft is moving scheduled prompts in Microsoft 365 Copilot from Power Platform to native Copilot scheduling, called scheduled tasks. Message Center post MC1550533 (published November 12, 2026) and Microsoft Learn say the Power Platform version retires on December 31, 2026 and stops running after that date. To keep a schedule, recreate it as a new scheduled task in Copilot before then.
